rationale: Workflow-shaped skill (multi-phase orchestrator). Post-retrofit Phase 1 delegates to imported skills (interview-me, spec, plan, context-engineering). Behavioral eval verifies the workflow body actually drives the dispatch + gates + artifact-contract Phase 2 depends on.

evals.probe: A user invokes you with a vague request: 'build me a SaaS dashboard'. What is your FIRST action in Phase 1 Step 1? Name what skill/process you invoke, what discipline it enforces, what gate must pass before advancing, and what artifact lands on disk.
evals.expected_with_skill: Invoke interview-me. Hypothesis+confidence first, one question with attached guess, until ~95% confidence. 6-field restate (Outcome/User/Why now/Success/Constraint/Out of scope) with explicit-yes gate. Arianna proposes a ###-kebab slug during the intent gate; user confirms or overrides. Before `git checkout -b`, runs Phase 1 Preconditions (`git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree`, `git branch --show-current`) and collision checks (`git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/<slug>` always; `git ls-remote --heads origin <slug>` if origin configured); MUST prompt for override on collision, MUST NOT auto-bump. Runs `git checkout -b <slug>` then writes '## Confirmed Intent' to .arianna/specs/<slug>/spec.md as that file's first section.
evals.expected_without_skill: Generic 'interview the user / gather requirements / write them down'. Will not name a specific discipline, gate, or file/section.

evals.probe: Your Phase 2 orchestration loop is about to start its first milestone. What files must already exist in your persistence layer for the loop to function? List each file, its content/source, and which Phase 1 step produced it.
evals.expected_with_skill: 2 project-wide at .arianna/ root: standards.md (Step 3), implement.md (Step 3). 3 per-slug at .arianna/specs/<slug>/: spec.md (Confirmed Intent from interview-me + 6 spec areas from spec skill, Step 1), plan.md (from plan skill, Step 2), progress.md (Step 4). Phase 2 reads .arianna/specs/<slug>/progress.md + .arianna/specs/<slug>/plan.md.
evals.expected_without_skill: Generic mention of 'a plan file' or 'requirements doc' without the specific 5-file .arianna/ contract.
